# KodeKit - All-in-One Developer Toolkit

## Project Overview

KodeKit is a comprehensive web-based toolkit providing 50+ essential tools for developers, designers, and content creators. Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Material-UI, it offers a modern, privacy-focused platform for various file operations, calculations, and productivity tasks.

**Live URL**: https://kodekit.in
**Repository**: Next.js 14 App Router application
**License**: MIT

## Architecture & Tech Stack

### Core Technologies
- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Language**: TypeScript 5.5
- **UI Library**: Material-UI 5.14 + Tailwind CSS 3.4
- **Animation**: Framer Motion
- **Icons**: Lucide React + Material-UI Icons
- **PWA**: next-pwa for offline functionality
- **Package Manager**: Yarn

### Key Features
- **Privacy-First**: All processing happens client-side
- **PWA Ready**: Installable Progressive Web App
- **SEO Optimized**: Comprehensive metadata and structured data
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first design
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant
- **Performance**: Optimized for Core Web Vitals

## Project Structure

```
kodekit/
├── app/                    # Next.js App Router
│   ├── category/[categoryId]/  # Category pages
│   ├── tools/[toolName]/       # Individual tool pages
│   ├── layout.tsx             # Root layout with metadata
│   ├── page.tsx              # Homepage
│   ├── sitemap.ts            # Dynamic sitemap
│   └── robots.ts             # Robots.txt generation
├── components/               # React components
│   ├── tools/               # Individual tool components
│   ├── Header.tsx           # Site navigation
│   ├── Footer.tsx           # Site footer
│   ├── Hero.tsx             # Homepage hero
│   └── ToolGrid.tsx         # Tool listing grid
├── lib/                     # Utilities and data
│   ├── data/               # Static data
│   │   └── toolsData.ts    # Tool definitions and categories
│   ├── utils/              # Utility functions
│   │   ├── toolMetadata.ts # SEO metadata generation
│   │   ├── structuredData.ts # JSON-LD schemas
│   │   └── seo.ts          # SEO utilities
│   └── theme/              # Theme configuration
├── public/                 # Static assets
│   ├── social/            # Open Graph images
│   ├── manifest.json      # PWA manifest
│   └── robots.txt         # Static robots.txt
└── hooks/                 # Custom React hooks
```

## Tool Categories & Architecture

### 8 Main Categories (50+ Tools Total)

1. **PDF Tools** (5 tools)
   - Image to PDF Converter, PDF Merger, PDF Splitter, PDF Page Rotator, PDF Metadata Editor

2. **Text Tools** (4 tools)
   - Word Count, Text Case Converter, Lorem Ipsum Generator

3. **Design Tools** (6 tools)
   - Color Picker, Image Compressor, QR Code Generator, Gradient Generator

4. **Developer Tools** (12 tools)
   - JSON Formatter, JSON Compare, Base64 Encoder/Decoder, CSS Minifier, Regex Tester, JWT Decoder

5. **Math Tools** (9 tools)
   - Calculator, Unit Converter, Matrix Calculator, Statistics Calculator

6. **Finance Tools** (7 tools)
   - Loan Calculator, SIP Calculator, PPF Calculator, SSY Calculator

7. **Healthcare Tools** (3 tools)
   - BMI Calculator, Blood Pressure Calculator, Calorie Calculator

8. **Time Tools** (4 tools)
   - Time Converter, Timestamp Converter, Stopwatch, Countdown Timer

### Tool Data Structure

```typescript
interface ToolItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  icon: string;
  category: "pdf" | "text" | "design" | "developer" | "math" | "finance" | "healthcare" | "time";
  popular: boolean;
  route?: string;
}
```

## SEO & Metadata Architecture

### Comprehensive SEO Implementation
- **Dynamic Metadata**: Tool-specific titles, descriptions, and keywords
- **Structured Data**: JSON-LD schemas for WebApplication, Organization, BreadcrumbList
- **Open Graph**: Custom social images for each tool (1200x630)
- **Twitter Cards**: Large image cards with proper metadata
- **Canonical URLs**: Proper canonicalization for all pages
- **Sitemap**: Dynamic XML sitemap with priorities and change frequencies

### Metadata Generation Pattern
```typescript
// Each tool gets:
// Title: "{Tool Name} - Free Online Tool | KodeKit"
// Description: "{Tool description} - Free online {category} tool. No registration required, works in your browser."
// Keywords: Category-specific + general tool keywords (15 max)
// Custom OG image: /social/{tool-name}-kodekit.png
```

## Component Architecture

### Tool Component Pattern
All tools follow a consistent structure:

```typescript
// Standard tool component structure:
1. State management (useReducer pattern)
2. Input validation and error handling
3. Core functionality (client-side processing)
4. Results display with smooth scrolling
5. Export/copy functionality
6. Accessibility features (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation)
7. Responsive design (mobile-first)
```

### Example: JsonCompare Tool Features
- Visual diff highlighting with color coding
- Multiple input methods (paste, URL, base64)
- Real-time indent size adjustment
- Smooth scrolling to results
- Success/error state management
- Copy results functionality
- Accessibility compliance

## Development Guidelines

### Code Style & Patterns
- **TypeScript**: Strict mode enabled, comprehensive type definitions
- **React**: Functional components with hooks, useReducer for complex state
- **Material-UI**: Consistent component usage with theme integration
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first design with breakpoint considerations
- **Performance**: Code splitting, lazy loading, optimized images

### File Naming Conventions
- **Components**: PascalCase (e.g., `JsonCompare.tsx`)
- **Utilities**: camelCase (e.g., `toolMetadata.ts`)
- **Pages**: kebab-case routes (e.g., `/tools/json-compare`)
- **Assets**: kebab-case (e.g., `json-compare-kodekit.png`)

### State Management Pattern
```typescript
// Consistent reducer pattern for tools:
interface ToolState {
  // Input data
  // Processing state (loading, error)
  // Results data
  // UI state (copied, view mode)
}

type ToolAction = 
  | { type: "SET_INPUT"; payload: string }
  | { type: "SET_LOADING"; payload: boolean }
  | { type: "SET_RESULTS"; payload: any }
  | { type: "SET_ERROR"; payload: string | null };
```

## Performance Optimizations

### Next.js Optimizations
- **App Router**: Server-side rendering with static generation
- **Image Optimization**: WebP/AVIF formats with lazy loading
- **Bundle Splitting**: Vendor chunks, MUI chunks, common chunks
- **Code Splitting**: Dynamic imports for heavy components
- **Caching**: Aggressive caching strategies for static assets

### PWA Features
- **Service Worker**: Workbox-powered caching strategies
- **Offline Support**: Fallback pages and cached resources
- **Install Prompt**: Custom PWA installation experience
- **Background Sync**: For future offline functionality

## Security & Privacy

### Privacy-First Architecture
- **Client-Side Processing**: No data sent to servers
- **No Tracking**: Minimal analytics, no user data collection
- **Secure Headers**: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options
- **Input Sanitization**: XSS prevention in all tools

### Content Security Policy
```javascript
// Security headers in next.config.js:
"X-Frame-Options": "DENY"
"X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff"
"Referrer-Policy": "origin-when-cross-origin"
"Strict-Transport-Security": "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
```

## Deployment & Build

### Build Process
```bash
yarn clean          # Clean build artifacts
yarn build          # Next.js production build
yarn postbuild      # Generate sitemap
yarn validate       # Build validation
```

### Environment Configuration
```env
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://kodekit.in
NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADSENSE_ID=ca-pub-xxxxxxxxx
NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION=xxxxxxxxx
```

### Deployment Platform
- **Primary**: Vercel (optimized for Next.js)
- **CDN**: Vercel Edge Network
- **Analytics**: Google AdSense integration
- **Monitoring**: Built-in performance monitoring

## Adding New Tools

### Step-by-Step Process
1. **Create Component**: `components/tools/NewTool.tsx`
2. **Add Tool Data**: Update `lib/data/toolsData.ts`
3. **Add Route**: Create `app/tools/new-tool/page.tsx`
4. **Add Metadata**: Update `lib/utils/toolMetadata.ts`
5. **Add Social Image**: Create `/public/social/new-tool-kodekit.png`
6. **Test & Validate**: Ensure responsive design and accessibility

### Tool Component Template
```typescript
"use client";
import React, { useReducer, useCallback } from "react";
import { Container, Typography, Paper, Button } from "@mui/material";
import Navigation from "@/components/Navigation";

// State interface, reducer, component logic...
// Follow existing patterns in JsonCompare.tsx
```

## Testing & Quality Assurance

### Validation Scripts
- `yarn seo:validate` - SEO metadata validation
- `yarn seo:test-structured` - Structured data validation
- `yarn analyze:bundle` - Bundle size analysis
- `yarn type-check` - TypeScript validation

### Performance Targets
- **Lighthouse Score**: 95+ across all metrics
- **Core Web Vitals**: LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1
- **Bundle Size**: Main bundle < 250KB gzipped
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance

## API & Integration Points

### External Dependencies
- **Google Fonts**: Inter font family
- **Google AdSense**: Monetization (optional)
- **Vercel Analytics**: Performance monitoring
- **PDF Libraries**: pdf-lib, jsPDF for PDF tools
- **Chart Libraries**: Recharts for data visualization

### No Backend Dependencies
- All tools work entirely client-side
- No database or server-side processing
- No user authentication required
- No external API calls for core functionality

## Accessibility Features

### WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance
- **Keyboard Navigation**: Full keyboard accessibility
- **Screen Reader Support**: Proper ARIA labels and roles
- **Color Contrast**: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio
- **Focus Management**: Visible focus indicators
- **Semantic HTML**: Proper heading hierarchy and landmarks

### Implementation Examples
```typescript
// Proper ARIA labeling:
<TextField
  aria-labelledby="input-label"
  aria-describedby="input-help"
  aria-invalid={hasError}
/>

// Keyboard navigation:
onKeyDown={(e) => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSubmit();
}}
```

## Internationalization (Future)

### Prepared Architecture
- **i18n Ready**: Component structure supports translation
- **Text Externalization**: Hardcoded strings identified for extraction
- **RTL Support**: CSS prepared for right-to-left languages
- **Number Formatting**: Locale-aware number formatting in calculators

## Contributing Guidelines

### Code Quality Standards
- **TypeScript**: Strict typing, no `any` types
- **ESLint**: Next.js recommended configuration
- **Prettier**: Consistent code formatting
- **Git Hooks**: Pre-commit validation
- **Testing**: Component testing for critical functionality

### Pull Request Process
1. Fork repository and create feature branch
2. Follow existing code patterns and conventions
3. Add proper TypeScript types and documentation
4. Test on multiple devices and browsers
5. Ensure accessibility compliance
6. Update documentation if needed

This documentation provides a comprehensive understanding of the KodeKit project architecture, patterns, and development guidelines for LLMs and developers working with the codebase.
